## File: `references/languages/csharp.md`

### Detection signals — C#/.NET (Security: Operational)

Detection signals only. They cite no standard. Report findings against the element IDs listed (defined in
`../standards/`). A signal is evidence only on concrete code or an explicit setting (`SKILL.md` step 5). The only .NET
defaults a worker may rely on are those stated in `dotnet-operational.md` (DNO-06, DNO-07, DNO-10, DNO-11, DNO-12,
DNO-14). Serilog, NLog and log4net defaults are not localized: report explicit values only, and add a
`localized-standard-gap` note for a missing setting.

| Signal (API, setting or pattern) | Look in | Indicates | Element(s) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `app.UseDeveloperExceptionPage()` outside `if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment())` | `Program.cs`, `Startup.cs` | Developer page outside Development (always Error) | DNO-06, ERR-04 |
| `ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT`/`DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT` = `Development` | Dockerfile, compose, Kubernetes manifests, App Service settings, pipeline YAML | Production running as Development | DNO-03, DNO-07 |
| `<customErrors mode="Off">` | `web.config` | Detailed errors for remote users | ERR-04 |
| No `UseExceptionHandler` in the non-Development branch; `UseExceptionHandler()` with no path, lambda or `AddProblemDetails()` | `Program.cs`, `Startup.cs` | No global generic handler | DNO-04, DNO-08, ERR-01 |
| `AddExceptionHandler<T>()` without `UseExceptionHandler()` | `Program.cs` | Registered handler never runs | DNO-08 |
| `IExceptionHandlerFeature.Error.Message`/`.StackTrace`, `ex.ToString()` written to the response or `ProblemDetails.Detail` | handlers, middleware, filters, controllers | Error details sent to clients | DNO-09, ERR-02 |
| `TryHandleAsync` returning `true` without a logger call; `SuppressDiagnosticsCallback` returning `true` broadly | `IExceptionHandler` classes, `Program.cs` | Handled exceptions not logged (.NET 10 default) | DNO-10 |
| Empty `catch { }`, `catch (Exception) { return null; }` without logging | any code | Swallowed errors | A10-07, LOG-02 |
| `.NET Framework` `WebApiConfig` without `IExceptionLogger` and `IExceptionHandler` replaced | `App_Start/WebApiConfig.cs` | No global Web API handler | ERR-06 |
| `_logger.Log*($"…{x}…")` or `"…" + x` templates; CA2254 suppressed | any code, `.editorconfig`, `GlobalSuppressions.cs` | Non-constant templates | DNO-16, LOG-17 |
| `AddHttpLogging(o => o.LoggingFields = HttpLoggingFields.All \| RequestBody …)`; `RequestHeaders.Add("Authorization"\|"Cookie")` | `Program.cs` | Sensitive headers/bodies in HTTP logs | DNO-14 |
| Passwords, tokens, `ConnectionString`, `Authorization` values, whole request/user objects passed to logger calls | any code | Secrets or sensitive data in logs | LOG-12, LOG-13 |
| `[DataClassification]`/sensitive attributes present but no `AddRedaction` | models, `Program.cs` | Sensitive fields logged without redaction | DNO-15 |
| `Password=`, `AccountKey=`, `ClientSecret`, `ApiKey` with real values | `appsettings*.json`, `web.config` `connectionStrings`, code | Hardcoded secrets | DNO-01, SMG-01 |
| `AddUserSecrets` outside Development; Secret Manager or `secrets.json` referenced for production | `Program.cs`, deployment docs/scripts | Development-only store in production | DNO-02, DNO-12 |
| Secret-store or cloud credentials in config: `ClientSecretCredential`/client secrets (Azure Key Vault), `AWSAccessKeyId`/`aws_secret_access_key` or `BasicAWSCredentials` (AWS Secrets Manager), Vault tokens/AppRole secret IDs (HashiCorp Vault) | `Program.cs`, `appsettings*.json` | Secret-zero in config instead of a workload identity | DNO-13 |
| `PersistKeysTo*` (e.g. `PersistKeysToFileSystem`, `PersistKeysToDbContext`, `PersistKeysToStackExchangeRedis`, `PersistKeysToAzureBlobStorage`, `PersistKeysToAWSSystemsManager`) without `ProtectKeysWith*` | `Program.cs` | Unprotected Data Protection keys | DNO-05 |
| `http://` secret-store URLs (Key Vault, Secrets Manager, Vault, …); certificate validation disabled for them | config, `Program.cs` | Secrets in plaintext transit | SMG-11 |
| Serilog/NLog file sinks under `wwwroot`; no `fileSizeLimitBytes`/`rollingInterval`/`retainedFileCountLimit`/archive limits (explicit values only) | `appsettings*.json` `Serilog`, `nlog.config` | Web-accessible or unbounded log files | LOG-22, LOG-21 |
| Minimum level `None`/`Off` for the app or security categories in production config | `appsettings.Production.json` `Logging`, `Serilog` | Logging deactivated | LOG-19 |
| Security events written with `Console.WriteLine`/`Debug.WriteLine` | admin, export, startup code | Not using the logging framework | LOG-11 |
| User-admin, role-change, export or import endpoints with no logger call | controllers, minimal-API endpoints | Higher-risk functions not logged | LOG-04 |
| Catch blocks in authorization handlers or policy code that `return true`/`context.Succeed` on exception | `IAuthorizationHandler`, filters | Fail open | A10-05 |
| Several `SaveChanges`/repository writes without `BeginTransaction`/a single unit of work | services, repositories | No rollback for part-way writes | A10-03, SCR-03 |
| `Stream`/`SqlConnection`/`SemaphoreSlim` without `using`/`finally` | any code | Resources not released on exceptions | A10-06 |

## File: `references/standards/dotnet-operational.md`

*Load rule: DNO-01…16. Load when language `csharp` is detected.*

### .NET / ASP.NET Core operational security guidance — localized summary

- Applies when language `csharp` is detected. ASP.NET Core elements (DNO-03, -04, -06 … -12, -14) apply when
  `Microsoft.AspNetCore.*` or `Microsoft.NET.Sdk.Web` is used; DNO-05 when ASP.NET Core Data Protection is configured;
  DNO-13 when the app reads secrets from an external secret store (any vendor) or runs on a platform that offers a
  workload identity; DNO-01, -02, -15,
  -16 always. ERR-06 (in `owasp-operational.md`) applies only to .NET Framework Web API projects.
- Level: a vendor element takes the level of the OWASP element it supports, or `SHOULD` when the vendor only
  recommends. **(Default)** marks an element that states API behaviour or a default; cite the OWASP element it supports
  and name the DNO element in the recommendation. Where vendor guidance is weaker than an OWASP element, the OWASP
  element decides. Severity rules are in `../../SKILL.md`.
- Defaults stated here are the only .NET defaults a worker may rely on. Serilog, NLog and log4net sink, enricher and
  destructuring defaults are **not** localized: report only explicit insecure settings there, and add a
  `localized-standard-gap` note for a missing setting.

| ID | Level | Requirement (summary) | Code/config evidence | Check |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| DNO-01 | MUST | Keep secrets out of source code and checked-in configuration. | credentials in `appsettings*.json`, `web.config`, code | SEC-OP-05 |
| DNO-02 | MUST | Use User Secrets only for development (it isn't encrypted storage); get production credentials from a managed secret store. | `AddUserSecrets` outside Development; production secrets in user-secrets docs/scripts | SEC-OP-06 |
| DNO-03 | MUST | Run production apps outside the Development environment. | `ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development` in production Dockerfile/manifests/launch config | SEC-OP-07 |
| DNO-04 | MUST | Use exception-handling middleware that returns generic errors; keep stack traces, credentials and request details out of responses. | no `UseExceptionHandler` in non-Development pipeline | SEC-OP-01 |
| DNO-05 | MUST | Protect ASP.NET Core Data Protection keys: when overriding key persistence, configure encryption at rest and restrict access to the key repository. | `PersistKeysTo*` without `ProtectKeysWith*` | SEC-OP-06 |
| DNO-06 | MUST | **(Default)** The developer exception page is on by default only in Development, for apps built with `WebApplication.CreateBuilder`; older templates call `UseDeveloperExceptionPage`. It shows stack trace, query, cookies and headers. Don't enable it outside Development. | `app.UseDeveloperExceptionPage()` not gated on `IsDevelopment()` | SEC-OP-07 |
| DNO-07 | MUST | **(Default)** If the environment isn't set, it is Production, which disables most debugging features; `DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT`, if present, takes precedence over `ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT` for `CreateBuilder` apps. | environment variables set to Development in deployment files | SEC-OP-07 |
| DNO-08 | MUST | Non-Development pipelines call `UseExceptionHandler` with a path, a lambda, or `AddProblemDetails()`; registered `IExceptionHandler`s are never called without it. | `AddExceptionHandler<T>()` but no `UseExceptionHandler()` | SEC-OP-01 |
| DNO-09 | MUST | Error pages, lambdas and `IExceptionHandler`s don't serve sensitive error information (exception messages, details) to clients. | `exceptionHandlerPathFeature.Error.Message` written to the response | SEC-OP-01 |
| DNO-10 | MUST | **(Default)** From .NET 10, when an `IExceptionHandler` returns `true`, logs and metrics for that exception are suppressed by default (.NET 8/9 always emitted them); log in the handler or set `SuppressDiagnosticsCallback`. | `TryHandleAsync` returns `true` without logging | SEC-OP-02 |
| DNO-11 | SHOULD | **(Default)** Environment variables are commonly stored as plain, unencrypted text and are readable by untrusted parties if the machine or process is compromised. | (supports SMG-07 recommendations; never fails on its own) | SEC-OP-06 |
| DNO-12 | MUST | **(Default)** Secret Manager stores values unencrypted in a JSON file in the user profile, outside the project tree; it's for development only and isn't a trusted store. | code reading `secrets.json` paths; Secret Manager referenced for production | SEC-OP-06 |
| DNO-13 | SHOULD | Apps authenticate to their secret store or cloud APIs with the hosting platform's workload identity (e.g. Azure managed identity via `DefaultAzureCredential`, AWS IAM roles via the default credential chain, GCP workload identity, Kubernetes service-account tokens) instead of client secrets, access keys or certificates kept in configuration. Generalized 2026-11-12 from the source's Azure-only wording; the source's non-Azure path (X.509 certificate) is acceptable only when no workload identity exists. | secret-store client secret, cloud access key or `ClientSecretCredential` values in config | SEC-OP-06 |
| DNO-14 | MUST | **(Default)** HTTP logging logs request/response properties and headers by default (`LoggingFields` = `RequestPropertiesAndHeaders \| ResponsePropertiesAndHeaders`), header values only for names in `RequestHeaders`/`ResponseHeaders` (others `[Redacted]`), bodies only when enabled; it can log PII. Don't allowlist sensitive headers or log sensitive bodies. | `RequestHeaders.Add("Authorization")`; `HttpLoggingFields.RequestBody`/`All` | SEC-OP-03 |
| DNO-15 | SHOULD | Use the .NET redaction framework (`AddRedaction` with data classification) when logging potentially sensitive data. | sensitive fields logged without redaction | SEC-OP-03 |
| DNO-16 | SHOULD | Use log message templates with named placeholders and arguments, not string interpolation (analyzer CA2254: template should be a static expression). | `_logger.LogInformation($"User {name}")` | SEC-OP-04 |
